description: List the saved pose files available on disk (UserData/studio/pose/*.dat). Returns paths usable as-is with studio_set_character_pose. A pose file is sex-specific: it can only be applied to a character of the same sex.

sex.description: only return poses applicable to characters of this sex

query.description: case-insensitive substring matched against the pose name and its path

path.description: path relative to the pose folder, pass this to studio_set_character_pose

name.description: name the pose was saved under in Studio
